entries.meaningZh: agba：非洲阿勃木，一种木材名称
entries.en: The timber samples included a pale piece of agba.
entries.zh: 木材样品中有一块浅色阿勃木。

entries.en: The old directory shortens agency to agcy.
entries.zh: 旧名录把agency缩写为agcy.。

entries.en: The policy aims to reduce age discrimination in recruitment.
entries.zh: 这项政策旨在减少招聘中的年龄歧视。

entries.en: The club serves children in the five-to-eight age range.
entries.zh: 俱乐部面向五至八岁的儿童。

entries.en: She works in aged care three days a week.
entries.zh: 她每周从事三天老年照护工作。

entries.meaningZh: agencia：西班牙语的代理机构或办事处
entries.en: The Spanish address lists an agencia beside the station.
entries.zh: 西班牙语地址表在车站旁列出一家代理处。

entries.en: The template leaves AgendaTitle blank until a meeting name is entered.
entries.zh: 模板在输入会议名称前让议程标题字段保持空白。

entries.meaningZh: Agenise：原资料中尚未确认的词形
entries.en: The proofreader queried Agenise rather than accepting the translation dear.
entries.zh: 校对员对Agenise提出疑问，而没有直接采纳亲爱的这一译法。

entries.meaningZh: agentia：拉丁语中作用剂或药剂的复数形式
entries.en: The old Latin catalogue groups the agentia under separate headings.
entries.zh: 旧拉丁语目录把这些药剂分列在不同标题下。

entries.meaningZh: agent provocateur：煽动者；诱使他人违法以便揭发的人
entries.en: The novelist leaves it unclear whether the visitor is an agent provocateur.
entries.zh: 小说家没有说清来客是否是一个挑拨设局的人。

entries.meaningZh: Agfacolour：爱克发彩色摄影产品或工艺名称
entries.en: The photography archive contains an Agfacolour packet.
entries.zh: 摄影档案保存着一个爱克发彩色摄影产品包装。

entries.meaningZh: agglutinophore：凝集相关结构的旧免疫学名称
entries.en: The historical immunology diagram labels one part agglutinophore.
entries.zh: 历史免疫学示意图把其中一部分标为agglutinophore。

entries.meaningZh: agglutinoid：旧免疫学中的类凝集素名称
entries.en: The old glossary distinguishes agglutinoid from agglutinin.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表区分类凝集素与凝集素。

entries.en: The instrument inventory includes an agglutometer.
entries.zh: 仪器清单中有一台凝集测定器。

entries.en: The materials report compares the particles' aggregability.
entries.zh: 材料报告比较了这些颗粒的聚集能力。

entries.en: The economics lecture distinguishes aggregate demand from demand for one product.
entries.zh: 经济学讲课区分了总需求与对单一产品的需求。

entries.en: The laboratory equipment catalogue lists an aggregometer.
entries.zh: 实验室设备目录列有一台聚集测定仪。

entries.meaningZh: aggressive-growth：以高增长为目标、风险偏高的投资风格的
entries.en: The brochure describes the fund as an aggressive-growth portfolio.
entries.zh: 宣传册把这只基金称为进取型增长投资组合。

entries.meaningZh: AGH：瑞典恩厄尔霍尔姆—赫尔辛堡机场代码
entries.en: The baggage tag showed AGH beside the flight number.
entries.zh: 行李牌在航班号旁印着AGH。

entries.meaningZh: more agile：更加敏捷的；agiler为较少见比较形式
entries.en: The smaller robot was more agile in the narrow passage.
entries.zh: 较小的机器人在狭窄通道里更灵活。

entries.en: The old storyteller says he has nothing aginer the plan.
entries.zh: 老讲故事的人用方言说，他并不反对这个计划。

entries.meaningZh: agios：货币兑换溢价或贴水的复数形式
entries.en: The historical account lists the agios separately from the transaction fees.
entries.zh: 历史账目把兑换溢价与交易费分开列出。

entries.en: The diagram uses arrows to represent agitation of the liquid.
entries.zh: 示意图用箭头表示液体的搅动。

entries.meaningZh: AGL：above ground level，离地高度标记
entries.en: The diagram gives the height as 30 metres AGL.
entries.zh: 示意图把高度标为离地30米。

entries.meaningZh: Aglianico：阿里亚尼科葡萄品种或其葡萄酒
entries.en: The wine list offered an Aglianico from southern Italy.
entries.zh: 酒单上有一款来自意大利南部的阿里亚尼科葡萄酒。

entries.meaningZh: Aglypha：旧蛇类分类名，指无沟牙的一类
entries.en: The old zoological chart labels one group Aglypha.
entries.zh: 旧动物分类图把其中一组标为Aglypha。

entries.meaningZh: agmen：拉丁语的队列、集合，见于旧解剖用语
entries.en: The Latin glossary explains agmen as a column or collected group.
entries.zh: 拉丁语词汇表把agmen解释为队列或集合。

entries.en: The zoology chapter contrasts agnathan fishes with jawed fishes.
entries.zh: 动物学章节对比了无颌鱼类与有颌鱼类。

entries.en: The medical glossary cross-references agnathy to agnathia.
entries.zh: 医学词汇表把agnathy交叉指向无颌畸形。

entries.en: The Agnews invited their neighbours to dinner.
entries.zh: 阿格纽一家请邻居们来吃晚饭。

entries.meaningZh: Agnolin：含水羊毛脂的历史名称
entries.en: The pharmacy archive includes an old Agnolin label.
entries.zh: 药学档案中有一张旧Agnolin标签。

entries.meaningZh: agnostical：不可知论的；持保留判断立场的
entries.en: The author takes an agnostical position on the origin of consciousness.
entries.zh: 作者对意识的起源采取保留判断的立场。

entries.meaningZh: agnus-castus：穗花牡荆学名中的种加词
entries.en: The garden label gives the plant's name as Vitex agnus-castus.
entries.zh: 花园标签把植物学名写作穗花牡荆。

entries.meaningZh: agogô：阿戈戈铃，一种打击乐器
entries.en: The percussionist played an agogô beside the drum.
entries.zh: 打击乐手在鼓旁敲奏阿戈戈铃。

entries.meaningZh: agonad：旧资料中的无生殖腺者名称
entries.en: The historical glossary uses agonad as a descriptive noun.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表用agonad作描述性名词。

entries.meaningZh: agonia：拉丁或历史文献中的剧痛、濒死挣扎
entries.en: The Latin glossary translates agonia as agony.
entries.zh: 拉丁语词汇表把agonia解释为剧痛或痛苦挣扎。

entries.meaningZh: agonistics：竞技活动或竞争关系的研究，较正式用语
entries.en: The essay discusses agonistics in ancient public life.
entries.zh: 文章讨论了古代公共生活中的竞技与竞争。

entries.en: The mammal guide gives agouara as an older name for the crab-eating raccoon.
entries.zh: 哺乳动物指南把agouara列为食蟹浣熊的旧名。

entries.meaningZh: agpui：原资料中的树皮韧皮纤维名称
entries.en: The fibre catalogue lists agpui among bark fibres.
entries.zh: 纤维目录把agpui列在树皮纤维之中。

entries.meaningZh: AgraME：农业及畜牧业展会名称
entries.en: The exhibition booklet lists the AgraME exhibitors alphabetically.
entries.zh: 展会手册按字母顺序列出AgraME参展商。

entries.en: The narrator describes the unsettling feeling of agravity inside the spacecraft.
entries.zh: 叙述者描述了航天器内失重所带来的不安感觉。

entries.en: They followed the agreed-upon procedure for sharing the room.
entries.zh: 他们按照商定的办法共用这个房间。

entries.meaningZh: aggress：攻击；采取侵略行动，较罕见动词
entries.en: The historian asks why one state chose to aggress against another.
entries.zh: 历史学家探讨了一个国家为何选择侵犯另一个国家。

entries.en: The map marks a road leading towards Ağrı.
entries.zh: 地图标出了一条通往阿勒的道路。

entries.en: The report profiles an agribaron whose business began as a small farm.
entries.zh: 报告介绍了一位从小农场起家的农业企业巨头。

entries.meaningZh: agricolite：旧矿物名称，资料释闪铋矿
entries.en: The mineral drawer holds a specimen labelled agricolite.
entries.zh: 矿物抽屉里有一件标为agricolite的标本。

entries.meaningZh: Agrigentum：西西里古城阿格里真托的拉丁名称
entries.en: The historian describes the temples of ancient Agrigentum.
entries.zh: 历史学家描述了古代阿格里真托的神庙。

entries.en: The chemical-name index lists agrimonolide among plant-related compounds.
entries.zh: 化学名称索引把仙鹤草内酯列在植物相关化合物中。

entries.en: The old medical index uses agriopsoria for severe itching.
entries.zh: 旧医学索引用agriopsoria表示严重瘙痒。

entries.meaningZh: agrium：栽培群落的旧生态学名称
entries.en: The vegetation map uses agrium for the cultivated community.
entries.zh: 植被图用agrium表示栽培群落。

entries.meaningZh: agro-industry：农工业；农业相关加工业
entries.en: The report examines employment in agro-industry.
entries.zh: 报告研究了农工业的就业情况。

entries.meaningZh: Agroboy：旧英式俚语中与光头青年有关的称呼
entries.en: The cultural-history glossary marks Agroboy as dated slang.
entries.zh: 文化史词汇表把Agroboy标为过时俚语。

entries.en: The agricultural glossary compares agroecotype with the broader term ecotype.
entries.zh: 农业词汇表把农业生态型与更广义的生态型作了比较。

entries.en: The agricultural archive retains an Agromycin advertisement.
entries.zh: 农业档案保留着一则Agromycin广告。

entries.en: The historical pesticide index lists Agrosol as a trade name.
entries.zh: 历史农药索引把Agrosol列为商品名。

entries.en: The textbook introduces agrotechnique as a broad field of practical methods.
entries.zh: 教材把农业技术介绍为一类广泛的实用方法。

entries.en: The history-of-medicine glossary explains the old term agrypocoma.
entries.zh: 医学史词汇表解释了醒状昏迷这一旧术语。

entries.en: The Spanish menu lists agua con gas and agua sin gas.
entries.zh: 西班牙语菜单列出了气泡水和无气水。

entries.meaningZh: Ags.：墨西哥阿瓜斯卡连特斯州名称的缩写
entries.en: The Mexican address uses Ags. after the town name.
entries.zh: 墨西哥地址在城镇名称后使用了阿瓜斯卡连特斯州的缩写。

entries.en: The mineral collection includes a small aguilarite specimen.
entries.zh: 矿物收藏中有一件小型辉硒银矿标本。

entries.meaningZh: aguirin：原资料中的乙酸可可碱钠旧名
entries.en: The historical drug catalogue retains aguirin in the name column.
entries.zh: 历史药物目录在名称栏保留了aguirin。

entries.en: Her letters were agush with enthusiastic plans.
entries.zh: 她的信里热情洋溢，写满了各种计划。

entries.en: The freight form labels the actual gross weight AGW.
entries.zh: 货运表用AGW标记实际毛重。

entries.en: The historical calendar table includes an ahargana column.
entries.zh: 历史历法表有一栏列出积日数。

entries.meaningZh: AHBS：原资料中的抗人脑血清标记
entries.en: The historical serum catalogue includes the label AHBS.
entries.zh: 历史血清目录中有AHBS这一标签。

entries.en: The transport archive includes an AHCC meeting agenda.
entries.zh: 交通档案中有一份亚洲公路协调委员会会议议程。

entries.meaningZh: AHCPR：美国医疗保健政策与研究局的历史缩写
entries.en: The bibliography cites an old AHCPR report.
entries.zh: 参考文献引用了一份旧医疗保健政策与研究局报告。

entries.meaningZh: aheneus：拉丁语的铜色或青铜质的
entries.en: The Latin description uses aheneus for the bronze-coloured surface.
entries.zh: 拉丁语描述用aheneus形容青铜色的表面。

entries.meaningZh: ahhed：发出啊的惊叹声，ah的过去式
entries.en: Everyone oohed and ahhed as the curtain rose.
entries.zh: 幕布升起时，大家纷纷发出惊叹。

entries.en: The children were oohing and aahing over the enormous cake.
entries.zh: 孩子们对着巨大的蛋糕惊叹不已。

entries.en: The pharmacy archive keeps an Ahistan package insert.
entries.zh: 药学档案保存着一份Ahistan包装说明页。

entries.en: The chemical index groups chloroaniline with other substituted anilines.
entries.zh: 化学索引把氯苯胺与其他取代苯胺编在一起。

entries.meaningZh: ahmar：阿拉伯语的红色的，亦见于地名
entries.en: The guide explained ahmar while discussing the Arabic place name.
entries.zh: 导游讲解这个阿拉伯地名时，解释了表示红色的ahmar。

entries.meaningZh: aholehole：夏威夷的一类银色鱼的名称
entries.en: The fish guide includes an illustration labelled aholehole.
entries.zh: 鱼类指南有一幅标为aholehole的插图。

entries.en: Ahr left a spare copy of the map at the reception desk.
entries.zh: 阿尔在接待处留了一份备用地图。

entries.meaningZh: AHT：抗透明质酸酶试验的旧缩写
entries.en: The historical laboratory index expands AHT as an antihyaluronidase test.
entries.zh: 历史检验索引把AHT展开为抗透明质酸酶试验。

entries.en: The old glossary defines ahyperlipemia as the absence of hyperlipemia.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表把ahyperlipemia解释为不存在高脂血症。

entries.en: The exhibition catalogue acknowledges an AIA chapter.
entries.zh: 展览图录向美国建筑师学会的一个分会表示致谢。

entries.en: The medical index lists sialadenectomy under salivary-gland surgery.
entries.zh: 医学索引把涎腺切除术列在唾液腺手术之下。

entries.meaningZh: AIAW：美国校际女子体育协会的历史简称
entries.en: The sports archive holds an AIAW tournament booklet.
entries.zh: 体育档案中有一本校际女子体育协会赛事手册。

entries.en: The conference bibliography includes an AIBS publication.
entries.zh: 会议参考书目中有一份美国生物科学学会出版物。

entries.meaningZh: Aicamin：原资料中的阿卡明名称
entries.en: The old pharmaceutical catalogue lists Aicamin in its trade-name index.
entries.zh: 旧药品目录在商品名索引中列出了Aicamin。

entries.en: The accountant consulted an AICPA publication for the terminology.
entries.zh: 会计师查阅了一份美国注册会计师协会出版物，核对相关术语。

entries.en: The system sketch shows an AIDB connected to the search interface.
entries.zh: 系统草图显示，一个人工智能数据库与搜索界面相连。

entries.en: The general's aide-de-camp carried the sealed letter.
entries.zh: 将军的副官拿着那封封好的信。

entries.meaningZh: aidyrlite：杂硅铝镍矿，旧矿物名称
entries.en: The mineral inventory records a specimen under aidyrlite.
entries.zh: 矿物清单在aidyrlite名下记录了一件标本。

entries.meaningZh: AIEE：美国电气工程师学会的历史缩写
entries.en: The library keeps bound volumes of an old AIEE journal.
entries.zh: 图书馆保存着旧美国电气工程师学会期刊的合订本。

entries.meaningZh: AIF：澳大利亚帝国军，历史军队名称
entries.en: The museum caption identifies the uniform as an AIF uniform.
entries.zh: 博物馆说明牌把这套制服标为澳大利亚帝国军军服。

entries.meaningZh: AIFS：先进红外导引头的原缩略名
entries.en: The historical equipment index includes the initials AIFS.
entries.zh: 历史装备索引中列有AIFS这一缩写。

entries.meaningZh: AIH：使用配偶精子的人工授精的历史缩写
entries.en: The medical-history glossary explains the initials AIH.
entries.zh: 医学史词汇表解释了AIH这一缩写。

entries.meaningZh: AII：法国工业创新署的历史缩写
entries.en: The business-history archive contains an AII report.
entries.zh: 商业史档案中有一份法国工业创新署报告。

entries.en: Aike put the spare tickets in a labelled envelope.
entries.zh: 爱科把多余的票放在一个标好标签的信封里。

entries.meaningZh: alkylide：烃基化物的旧化学名称
entries.en: The old chemistry glossary contrasts alkylide with halide.
entries.zh: 旧化学词汇表对比了烃基化物与卤化物。

entries.en: The historical dermatology index uses allergid for an allergic eruption.
entries.zh: 历史皮肤病学索引用allergid指变应性皮疹。

entries.en: The daily timetable is pinned beside the door.
entries.zh: 每日时间表贴在门旁。

entries.meaningZh: AIME：美国采矿、冶金与石油工程师学会的历史名称缩写
entries.en: The engineering archive includes an old AIME conference volume.
entries.zh: 工程档案中有一册旧美国采矿、冶金与石油工程师学会会议文集。

entries.en: The old mineral label gives the name ainalite.
entries.zh: 旧矿物标签写着铁钽锡石这一名称。

entries.meaningZh: AINS：法语非甾体抗炎药的缩写
entries.en: The French leaflet uses AINS where an English leaflet would use NSAIDs.
entries.zh: 法语说明页用AINS，而英语说明页通常使用NSAIDs。

entries.meaningZh: AIOC：英伊石油公司的历史缩写
entries.en: The business-history archive includes an AIOC annual report.
entries.zh: 商业史档案中有一份英伊石油公司的年报。

entries.en: The chemical index lists diosmin with other flavonoid glycosides.
entries.zh: 化学索引把地奥司明与其他黄酮苷并列。

entries.meaningZh: aiphosis：皮肤色素缺乏的旧医学名
entries.en: The historical glossary lists aiphosis among pigmentation terms.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把aiphosis列在色素相关术语中。

entries.en: The mechanic checked the warning light for the airbag.
entries.zh: 机械师检查了安全气囊的警示灯。

entries.en: The museum caption identifies the cylinder as an air bottle.
entries.zh: 博物馆说明牌把这个圆筒标为储气瓶。

entries.en: A tiny air bubble was trapped beneath the glass.
entries.zh: 玻璃下面困着一个小气泡。

entries.en: The open doorway improved air circulation in the room.
entries.zh: 敞开的门口改善了室内空气流通。

entries.en: The aircrew stayed aboard while the aircraft was being cleaned.
entries.zh: 飞机清洁期间，机组人员留在机上。

entries.en: The reporter air-dashed to the capital after the announcement.
entries.zh: 公告发布后，记者匆忙乘飞机赶往首都。

entries.en: The engineering drawing labels the air feeder beside the chamber.
entries.zh: 工程图在腔室旁标出了送气装置。

entries.en: The diary describes her first air flight.
entries.zh: 日记描述了她第一次乘飞机的经历。

entries.meaningZh: air handling：空气处理或通风管理
entries.en: The building plan includes a separate room for air-handling equipment.
entries.zh: 建筑平面图设有单独的空气处理设备间。

entries.en: The box has an air hole in its lid.
entries.zh: 盒盖上有一个通气孔。

entries.en: The engineering chart labels one stage air injection.
entries.zh: 工程图表把一个阶段标为注入空气。

entries.en: An air layer separates the two panes of glass.
entries.zh: 两层玻璃之间有一个空气层。

entries.en: The airline sent a message about the delayed flight.
entries.zh: 航空公司发来一条航班延误通知。

entries.meaningZh: air pocket：气穴；局部空气空隙
entries.en: An air pocket remained beneath the protective film.
entries.zh: 保护膜下面留着一处空气空隙。

entries.en: The brochure has a section on air purification.
entries.zh: 宣传册有一个关于空气净化的章节。

entries.en: The seminar discussed the history of air safety.
entries.zh: 研讨会讨论了航空安全的历史。

entries.en: An airship floated above the harbour in the old photograph.
entries.zh: 旧照片中，一艘飞艇漂浮在港口上空。

entries.meaningZh: air-slaked：在空气中消解的，旧材料用语
entries.en: The historical materials list specifies air-slaked lime.
entries.zh: 历史材料清单列明了空气消解石灰。

entries.en: The museum catalogue includes a cast-iron air stove.
entries.zh: 博物馆目录中有一座铸铁热风炉。

entries.meaningZh: air taxi：出租小型飞机或按需航空服务
entries.en: The island guide mentions an air taxi service.
entries.zh: 岛屿指南提到一种按需小型飞机服务。

entries.meaningZh: air traffic control：空中交通管制
entries.en: The documentary follows a day in air traffic control.
entries.zh: 纪录片记录了空中交通管制工作的一天。

entries.meaningZh: airwave：空气中传播的波；复数常指广播频段
entries.en: The new station took to the airwaves in the spring.
entries.zh: 新电台在春季开始播音。

entries.meaningZh: air blasting：空气爆破的历史工程名称

entries.zh: 采矿史索引列有空气爆破。

entries.zh: 放射学教材在示例图像上标出了空气支气管征。

entries.zh: 示意图在主外壳上方画出一个气室。

entries.en: The owners decided to air-condition the upstairs rooms.
entries.zh: 业主决定给楼上的房间安装空调。

entries.en: The form asks for the aircraft type beside the registration number.
entries.zh: 表格在注册编号旁要求填写机型。

entries.meaningZh: Airdox：历史压气爆破装置名称
entries.en: The mining-history display includes an Airdox advertisement.
entries.zh: 采矿史展陈中有一则Airdox广告。

entries.en: She trained in hairdressing before opening her own salon.
entries.zh: 她开自己的美发店之前接受过美发培训。

entries.meaningZh: AIRFA：美国印第安人宗教自由法
entries.en: The legal-history syllabus includes AIRFA.
entries.zh: 法律史教学大纲中列有美国印第安人宗教自由法。

entries.en: The technical drawing labels the air hood above the work area.
entries.zh: 技术图纸在工作区上方标出了空气罩。

entries.meaningZh: air jacket：充气救生衣的旧称
entries.en: The maritime museum displays an early air jacket.
entries.zh: 海事博物馆展出了一件早期充气救生衣。

entries.meaningZh: airlog：飞行计程或记录仪的旧称
entries.en: The aviation inventory includes an airlog.
entries.zh: 航空器材清单中有一台airlog。

entries.en: The building-services catalogue lists air-moving equipment.
entries.zh: 楼宇设备目录列有通风设备。

entries.meaningZh: AIRPASS：航空拦截雷达与瞄准系统的历史名称
entries.en: The aviation-history glossary explains the initials AIRPASS.
entries.zh: 航空史词汇表解释了AIRPASS这一缩写。

entries.meaningZh: airportage：原资料中具体义未确认的旧词形
entries.en: The editor queried the unusual label airportage before translating it.
entries.zh: 编辑翻译前对airportage这个不常见标签提出了疑问。

entries.meaningZh: air shipper：办理航空货运的发货人或公司
entries.en: The air shipper attached the documents to the consignment.
entries.zh: 航空发货方把文件附在货物上。

entries.en: The instrument panel includes an old airspeedometer.
entries.zh: 仪表板上有一只旧式空速计。

entries.en: The report describes a brief air surge in the duct.
entries.zh: 报告描述了管道中一次短暂的气流突增。

entries.meaningZh: AirTrain：机场捷运系统常用名称
entries.en: They followed the AirTrain signs after collecting their luggage.
entries.zh: 取好行李后，他们循着机场捷运标志走去。

entries.meaningZh: airwash：用气流清洗或吹拂的技术动词
entries.en: The old process description uses airwash for the cleaning stage.
entries.zh: 旧流程描述用airwash表示气流清洁阶段。

entries.en: The company stores its transaction records in an AIS.
entries.zh: 公司把交易记录保存在会计信息系统中。

entries.meaningZh: AISS：新加坡澳大利亚国际学校的名称缩写
entries.en: The archived yearbook carries the AISS initials.
entries.zh: 存档年鉴上印着新加坡澳大利亚国际学校的缩写。

entries.meaningZh: AITE：自动电话交换台的原缩略名
entries.en: The telecommunications catalogue lists an AITE.
entries.zh: 通信设备目录中有一台自动电话交换台。

entries.meaningZh: aitiogenous：由外界刺激或原因引起反应的旧形容词
entries.en: The old glossary contrasts aitiogenous with terms for spontaneous activity.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表把外因引起反应的与自发活动相关用语作了对比。

entries.en: The old Aiwa cassette player still sat on the shelf.
entries.zh: 那台旧爱华磁带播放机仍放在搁板上。

entries.meaningZh: aiyo：哎哟，表示惊讶、焦急或感叹的亚洲英语用语
entries.en: Aiyo, I've left my keys upstairs again!
entries.zh: 哎哟，我又把钥匙落在楼上了！

entries.meaningZh: AJAI：抗干扰与抗相互干扰的原资料缩略标记
entries.en: The communications glossary lists AJAI under interference-related terms.
entries.zh: 通信词汇表把AJAI列在干扰相关术语中。

entries.meaningZh: AJC：澳大利亚赛马俱乐部的历史简称
entries.en: The sporting archive preserves an AJC race programme.
entries.zh: 体育档案保存着一份澳大利亚赛马俱乐部赛事手册。

entries.meaningZh: AJI：American Justice Institute，美国司法研究机构名称
entries.en: The bibliography cites an old AJI report.
entries.zh: 参考书目引用了一份旧美国司法研究机构报告。

entries.meaningZh: AJPH：American Journal of Public Health，《美国公共卫生杂志》
entries.en: The bibliography includes an article published in AJPH.
entries.zh: 参考文献中有一篇发表于《美国公共卫生杂志》的文章。

entries.en: The chemical-name index includes ajugalactone.
entries.zh: 化学名称索引中列有筋骨草内酯。

entries.meaningZh: akaganeite：四方纤铁矿或四方针铁矿名称
entries.en: The mineral collection includes an akaganeite specimen.
entries.zh: 矿物收藏中有一件四方针铁矿标本。

entries.en: The pharmacy-history display includes an Akarkine package.
entries.zh: 药学史展陈中有一件Akarkine包装。

entries.meaningZh: akazgine：非洲马钱子碱的旧名称
entries.en: The historical alkaloid index lists akazgine.
entries.zh: 历史生物碱索引列有akazgine。

entries.meaningZh: akcethin：原资料中的硫乙酸甘油酯名称
entries.en: The old chemical catalogue retains the spelling akcethin.
entries.zh: 旧化学目录保留了akcethin这一拼写。

entries.en: The compound-name index files akebigenin among plant-related entries.
entries.zh: 化合物名称索引把木通配基归在植物相关条目中。

entries.en: The geological inventory records a sample labelled akenobeite.
entries.zh: 地质清单记录了一件标为明延岩的样品。

entries.meaningZh: AKEY：访问键的字段或标记名
entries.en: The interface notes label the access key AKEY.
entries.zh: 接口笔记把访问键标为AKEY。

entries.en: Akiba chose a seat near the back of the hall.
entries.zh: 阿基巴选了大厅后面附近的座位。

entries.meaningZh: akindle：燃烧着的；被点亮的，旧式修辞
entries.en: At dusk, the windows seemed akindle with golden light.
entries.zh: 黄昏时，窗户仿佛燃起了金色光芒。

entries.en: The historical antibiotic index cross-references akitamycin to toyamycin.
entries.zh: 历史抗生素索引把akitamycin交叉指向toyamycin。

entries.meaningZh: acmite：锥辉石的旧名称或拼写
entries.en: The old mineral label reads acmite.
entries.zh: 旧矿物标签写着锥辉石。

entries.meaningZh: AKOR：原资料中的经济与管理运筹学组织标记
entries.en: The conference archive includes a booklet marked AKOR.
entries.zh: 会议档案中有一本标着AKOR的手册。

entries.meaningZh: ALP：碱性磷酸酶的通常英语缩写

entries.zh: 词汇表用ALP表示碱性磷酸酶。

entries.zh: 矿物柜中有一件标为球砷锰矿的标本。

entries.en: The pharmacy archive preserves an Aktisol-Weiss label.

entries.en: The materials catalogue lists Akulon in the trade-name index.
entries.zh: 材料目录在商品名索引中列出了阿库纶。

entries.en: The medical glossary cross-references kala-azar to visceral leishmaniasis.
entries.zh: 医学词汇表把黑热病交叉指向内脏利什曼病。

entries.meaningZh: Alachua：阿拉楚阿，佛罗里达地名

entries.zh: 回邮地址在阿拉楚阿。

entries.en: The historical materials table lists alader beside other aluminium alloys.
entries.zh: 历史材料表把alader与其他铝合金并列。

entries.en: The textile archive records Alagia on the sample label.
entries.zh: 纺织档案在样品标签上记录了Alagia。

entries.meaningZh: alalauwa：夏威夷鱼类的地方名称
entries.en: The fish guide preserves alalauwa as a local name.
entries.zh: 鱼类指南保留了alalauwa这一地方名称。

entries.meaningZh: Alamalt：原资料中的阿拉玛特名称
entries.en: The archive preserves Alamalt exactly as printed on the packet.
entries.zh: 档案按包装原样保留了Alamalt这一名称。

entries.en: The mineral index includes alamosite.
entries.zh: 矿物索引中列有铅辉石。

entries.en: The atlas includes a map of Åland.
entries.zh: 地图册中有一张奥兰群岛地图。

entries.en: The enzyme-name index lists allantoicase.
entries.zh: 酶名称索引中列有尿囊酸酶。

entries.meaningZh: ALAP：as late as possible，尽可能晚的调度方式
entries.en: The scheduling diagram labels the second plan ALAP.
entries.zh: 调度示意图把第二个方案标为尽可能晚的调度。

entries.meaningZh: alare：鼻翼端的解剖测量标志点
entries.en: The anatomical diagram marks the alare on each side of the nose.
entries.zh: 解剖示意图在鼻子两侧标出了鼻翼端点。

entries.en: The facility report has a section on alarm monitoring.
entries.zh: 设施报告有一个关于警报监视的章节。

entries.meaningZh: alastor：复仇精灵；文学中的复仇者
entries.en: The poem presents the pursuer as an alastor.
entries.zh: 诗中把追逐者写成一个复仇精灵。

entries.en: A cluster of alates gathered near the porch light.
entries.zh: 一群有翅型昆虫聚在门廊灯附近。

entries.en: The old dyeing manual lists alum in its materials index.
entries.zh: 旧染色手册在材料索引中列出了明矾。

entries.meaningZh: alautun：玛雅长纪历中的大型计时单位
entries.en: The calendar-history table includes alautun among the long-count units.
entries.zh: 历法史表把alautun列在长纪历计时单位中。

entries.meaningZh: alazon：喜剧或修辞中的自夸者角色
entries.en: The playwright gives the alazon a speech full of empty boasts.
entries.zh: 剧作家给自夸者角色安排了一段空洞吹嘘的台词。

entries.meaningZh: Albamycin：新生霉素的历史商品名
entries.en: The old pharmacy catalogue cross-references Albamycin to novobiocin.
entries.zh: 旧药学目录把Albamycin交叉指向新生霉素。

entries.meaningZh: albar：阿尔巴棉，旧纺织材料名
entries.en: The textile catalogue includes a sample labelled albar.
entries.zh: 纺织目录中有一件标为阿尔巴棉的样品。

entries.meaningZh: ALBC：铝青铜铸件的原缩略标记
entries.en: The parts list uses ALBC for the aluminium-bronze casting.
entries.zh: 零件表用ALBC表示铝青铜铸件。

entries.en: The Albees brought their dog to the picnic.
entries.zh: 奥尔比一家带着狗来参加野餐。

entries.meaningZh: albernus：阿尔伯纳斯薄呢，旧布料名称
entries.en: The fabric archive keeps a swatch labelled albernus.
entries.zh: 面料档案保存着一块标为albernus的布样。

entries.en: She stopped at Albertsons for milk.
entries.zh: 她顺路到Albertsons超市买牛奶。

entries.meaningZh: albidus：拉丁语的微白的，见于学名
entries.en: The Latin glossary explains albidus as whitish.
entries.zh: 拉丁语词汇表把albidus解释为微白的。

entries.meaningZh: albimycin：原资料中的抗生素旧名称
entries.en: The historical antibiotic index retains albimycin in its original spelling.
entries.zh: 历史抗生素索引保留了albimycin的原拼写。

entries.en: The manuscript attributes the commentary to Albinus.
entries.zh: 手稿把这份评注署于阿尔比努斯名下。

entries.en: The language table uses Alb. for Albanian.
entries.zh: 语言表用Alb.表示阿尔巴尼亚语。

entries.meaningZh: albocinereous：灰白色的；由灰质与白质构成的旧形容词
entries.en: The historical description calls the tissue albocinereous.
entries.zh: 历史描述把这种组织称为灰白相间的。

entries.meaningZh: Albolene：白凡士林类产品的历史名称
entries.en: The pharmacy archive preserves an Albolene tin.
entries.zh: 药学档案保存着一个Albolene罐。

entries.zh: 历史抗生素索引列有白丝菌素。

entries.zh: 化合物名称索引列有白诺氏菌素。

entries.en: The geological catalogue records an alboranite sample.
entries.zh: 地质目录记录了一件拉长安山岩样品。

entries.meaningZh: albricia：报喜酬礼，西班牙语借词的旧用法
entries.en: The old travel account mentions an albricia paid to the messenger.
entries.zh: 旧游记提到给报信者的一份酬礼。

entries.en: The surgical-history index includes albuginectomy.
entries.zh: 外科史索引中列有白膜切除术。

entries.en: The laboratory-history chapter lists albuminometry among older analytical terms.
entries.zh: 实验室史章节把白蛋白定量测定列在较早的分析术语中。

entries.meaningZh: albuminone：白蛋白相关分解产物的旧名称
entries.en: The old protein glossary retains albuminone as a historical entry.
entries.zh: 旧蛋白质词汇表保留了albuminone这一历史条目。

entries.meaningZh: albumosaemia：血中出现蛋白胨或白蛋白消化产物的旧称
entries.en: The medical historian kept albumosaemia in the transcription of the original heading.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者在转录原始标题时保留了albumosaemia。

entries.en: The index cross-references albumosemia to albumosaemia.
entries.zh: 索引把albumosemia交叉指向albumosaemia。

entries.meaningZh: albus：拉丁语白色的，常见于学名
entries.en: The botanical label gives the name Lupinus albus.
entries.zh: 植物标签给出的学名是白羽扇豆。

entries.meaningZh: alkalescent：微碱性的；逐渐呈碱性的
entries.en: The old chemistry glossary defines alkalescent as slightly alkaline.
entries.zh: 旧化学词汇表把alkalescent解释为微碱性的。

entries.meaningZh: Alcan：加拿大铝业公司的历史名称
entries.en: The industrial archive contains an Alcan brochure.
entries.zh: 工业档案中有一份加拿大铝业公司的宣传册。

entries.meaningZh: Alcantarine：与阿尔坎塔拉派方济各会有关的
entries.en: The historian describes an Alcantarine community in the chapter on religious orders.
entries.zh: 历史学家在宗教修会一章中描述了一个阿尔坎塔拉派团体。

entries.en: The old bestiary uses alcatras for a large seabird.
entries.zh: 旧动物志用alcatras指一种大型海鸟。

entries.meaningZh: Alcheringa：澳大利亚原住民传统梦创时代观念的名称
entries.en: The exhibition explains Alcheringa through stories associated with the landscape.
entries.zh: 展览通过与地景相关的故事解释梦创时代观念。

entries.en: An alcid surfaced near the boat and dived again.
entries.zh: 一只海雀在船旁浮出水面，又潜了下去。

entries.zh: 社会史章节讨论了公众对酒精滥用的态度。

entries.zh: 菜单把含酒精饮料与软饮料分开。

entries.en: The textbook includes alcoholometry in a chapter on measuring liquids.
entries.zh: 教材在液体测量一章中介绍了酒精含量测定。

entries.en: The medical-history exhibition includes a section on alcoholotherapy.
entries.zh: 医学史展览有一部分介绍历史上的酒精疗法。

entries.en: A small alcove held a reading chair and a lamp.
entries.zh: 一个小凹室里放着阅读椅和灯。

entries.en: The Alcotts offered us a lift to the station.
entries.zh: 奥尔科特一家提出开车送我们去车站。

entries.meaningZh: ALCP：酒精相关慢性胰腺炎的缩写
entries.en: The medical glossary expands ALCP as alcoholic chronic pancreatitis.
entries.zh: 医学词汇表把ALCP展开为酒精相关慢性胰腺炎。

entries.en: The computer diagram labels the arithmetic, logic and control unit ALCU.
entries.zh: 计算机示意图用ALCU标记算术逻辑与控制单元。

entries.meaningZh: Alcyonaria：珊瑚类的一种旧分类名称
entries.en: The old zoological chart includes a group labelled Alcyonaria.
entries.zh: 旧动物分类图中有一组标为Alcyonaria。

entries.en: The textile archive includes a swatch labelled alcyonne.
entries.zh: 纺织档案中有一块标为翠鸟缎的布样。

entries.meaningZh: aldalcoketose：原资料中的醛醇酮糖名称
entries.en: The old carbohydrate table includes the term aldalcoketose.
entries.zh: 旧糖类表中出现了aldalcoketose这一名称。

entries.en: The historical materials table lists aldary among copper alloys.
entries.zh: 历史材料表把aldary列在铜合金中。

entries.en: The historical enzyme index uses aldehydase beside newer enzyme names.
entries.zh: 历史酶名称索引把aldehydase与较新的酶名并列。

entries.en: The Aldersons brought chairs for the outdoor concert.
entries.zh: 奥尔德森一家为户外音乐会带来了椅子。

entries.en: The materials index gives aldocellulose its own entry.
entries.zh: 材料索引为醛基纤维素设有独立条目。

entries.en: The diagram distinguishes an aldofuranoside from an aldopyranoside.
entries.zh: 示意图区分了呋喃醛糖苷与吡喃醛糖苷。

entries.en: The nomenclature exercise groups the aldonolactones together.
entries.zh: 命名练习把醛糖酸内酯归在一起。

entries.en: The endocrine glossary includes aldosteronoma.
entries.zh: 内分泌词汇表中列有醛固酮分泌瘤。

entries.meaningZh: ALDRI：自动低数据率输入的原缩略名
entries.en: The interface chart labels the low-data-rate input ALDRI.
entries.zh: 接口图用ALDRI标记低数据率输入。

entries.en: The circuit diagram labels the analogue line driver ALD.
entries.zh: 电路图用ALD标记模拟线路驱动器。

entries.en: The guests were already waiting outside.
entries.zh: 客人们已经在外面等着了。

entries.en: The small lamp was carved from alabaster.
entries.zh: 这盏小灯由雪花石膏雕成。

entries.meaningZh: alector：旧资料中凤冠雉的名称
entries.en: The old bird catalogue lists alector among large forest birds.
entries.zh: 旧鸟类目录把alector列在大型森林鸟类中。

entries.meaningZh: alegría：一种用苋籽制成的墨西哥甜食

entries.zh: 市场摊位出售用纸包着的小块苋籽甜食。

entries.zh: 集合论课用自然数介绍阿列夫零。

entries.en: The food-history collection includes an Alerdex tin.
entries.zh: 食品史收藏中有一个Alerdex罐。

entries.en: The vegetation glossary describes an aletophyte as a plant of village margins.
entries.zh: 植被词汇表把aletophyte描述为村落边缘的植物。

entries.meaningZh: aleukaemia：历史白细胞相关医学术语
entries.en: The medical historian kept aleukaemia distinct from the modern terms in the index.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者在索引中把aleukaemia与现代术语区分开。

entries.en: The botanical index includes an entry for Aleurites.
entries.zh: 植物学索引中有油桐属的条目。

entries.en: Alexandre stacked the chairs after the meeting.
entries.zh: 亚历山大会后把椅子叠放起来。

entries.en: The jewellery case held a ring set with alexandrite.
entries.zh: 珠宝盒里有一枚镶着变石的戒指。

entries.meaningZh: alexofixin：补体结合抗原的旧名称
entries.en: The historical immunology glossary includes alexofixin.
entries.zh: 历史免疫学词汇表中列有alexofixin。

entries.en: The French equipment list includes an alèse for the bed.
entries.zh: 法语设备清单中列有床用防污垫单。

entries.meaningZh: al fine：音乐术语，直到Fine标记处结束
entries.en: The score instructs the player to return to the opening and continue al fine.
entries.zh: 乐谱指示演奏者回到开头，并演奏至Fine结束标记。

entries.en: The fish guide includes an illustration of an alfonsino.
entries.zh: 鱼类指南中有一幅金眼鲷插图。

entries.meaningZh: ALF：原资料中的美国人寿相关组织标记
entries.en: The historical directory lists ALF in the organisations column.
entries.zh: 历史名录把ALF列在组织一栏。

entries.en: The diagram labels the sorting procedure ALG.
entries.zh: 示意图用ALG标记排序算法。

entries.meaningZh: algam：原资料中的铁皮材料旧名
entries.en: The materials archive preserves a sample labelled algam.
entries.zh: 材料档案保留着一件标为algam的样品。

entries.en: The historical glossary explains algefacient as cooling.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把algefacient解释为使清凉的。

entries.meaningZh: Algérie：阿尔及利亚的法语名称
entries.en: The French atlas labels the country Algérie.
entries.zh: 法语地图册把这个国家标为Algérie。

entries.en: The physiology diagram labels a nociceptor near the skin surface.
entries.zh: 生理学示意图在皮肤表面附近标出了伤害性感受器。

entries.meaningZh: algiomotor：与疼痛引发的运动有关的旧术语
entries.en: The old glossary uses algiomotor for a movement-related response to pain.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表用algiomotor指与疼痛有关的运动反应。

entries.en: The medical-history glossary gives algogenesia a descriptive entry.
entries.zh: 医学史词汇表为疼痛产生这一旧名列了描述性条目。

entries.meaningZh: algolagnic：与从疼痛获得性快感有关的
entries.en: The critic describes the scene as algolagnic without depicting it in detail.
entries.zh: 评论者把这一场景描述为带有从疼痛获得性快感的意味，但未详加描绘。

entries.en: The historical glossary places algopsychalia among terms for mental suffering.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把algopsychalia列在精神痛苦相关术语中。

entries.meaningZh: algosol：藻溶胶，原资料中的材料名
entries.en: The materials index lists algosol on a separate line.
entries.zh: 材料索引把藻溶胶单独列在一行。

entries.meaningZh: ALH：垂体前叶激素的旧缩略标记
entries.en: The historical endocrine chart uses ALH for anterior-lobe hormone.
entries.zh: 历史内分泌图用ALH表示垂体前叶激素。

entries.meaningZh: alkanet：紫草或其根，亦作染料名
entries.en: The old dyeing book lists alkanet in its index.
entries.zh: 旧染色书在索引中列有紫草根。

entries.en: Alistar brought a folding chair for the long wait.
entries.zh: 阿利斯塔尔带了一把折叠椅应付长时间等候。

entries.en: There were two Alices in our class, so we used their surnames.
entries.zh: 我们班有两个艾丽斯，所以我们用姓氏来区分她们。

entries.meaningZh: allidochlor：草毒死，历史除草剂名称
entries.en: The historical pesticide index lists allidochlor.
entries.zh: 历史农药索引列有草毒死。

entries.meaningZh: 财产让渡人；财产转让方
entries.en: The deed identifies the alienator as the former owner of the land.
entries.zh: 契据将财产让渡人列为这块土地的原所有者。

entries.meaningZh: alienization：异域化；使显得陌生的处理
entries.en: The critic discusses alienization in the translation of place names.
entries.zh: 评论者讨论了地名翻译中的异域化处理。

entries.en: The insect diagram marks the alifer beside the wing base.
entries.zh: 昆虫示意图在翅基旁标出了侧翅突。

entries.en: The text compares the political alignment of the two groups.
entries.zh: 文章比较了两个团体的政治结盟立场。

entries.meaningZh: Aliite：原资料中的未明确名称
entries.en: The editor kept Aliite in quotation marks pending clarification.
entries.zh: 编辑将Aliite保留在引号中，等待进一步澄清。

entries.en: The mineral cabinet contains an old label reading alimachite.
entries.zh: 矿物柜里有一张写着alimachite的旧标签。

entries.en: The charity's early records call its food supplier an alimenter.
entries.zh: 这家慈善机构的早期记录把食物供应者称为alimenter。

entries.en: The medical historian discusses alimentotherapy as an older term for treatment through diet.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者把alimentotherapy讨论为通过饮食治疗的旧称。

entries.en: The terminology table pairs aminating with amination.
entries.zh: 术语表把aminating与名词胺化配对。

entries.en: The materials table lists AlInGaP beside other compound semiconductors.
entries.zh: 材料表把铝铟镓磷与其他化合物半导体并列。

entries.en: The insect diagram labels the wing-bearing plate alinotum.
entries.zh: 昆虫示意图把具翅背板标为alinotum。

entries.meaningZh: 缺乏胆碱等促脂代谢因子的（旧实验营养学用语，形容饲料或饮食）
entries.en: The researchers compared an alipotropic rat diet with a diet containing choline.
entries.zh: 研究人员把缺乏促脂代谢因子的大鼠饲料，与含胆碱的饲料作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: ALIR：卢旺达解放军，历史武装组织简称
entries.en: The historian distinguishes ALIR from other groups in the conflict.
entries.zh: 历史学家把卢旺达解放军与冲突中的其他团体区分开。

entries.en: The botanical classification chart includes Alismatales.
entries.zh: 植物分类图中列有泽泻目。

entries.en: The mineral catalogue retains alisonite as a historical name.
entries.zh: 矿物目录把alisonite保留为历史名称。

entries.en: The historical surface-treatment index includes alitizing.
entries.zh: 历史表面处理索引列有渗铝处理。

entries.meaningZh: alizaein：原资料中的化合物旧名
entries.en: The editor preserved alizaein in the transcription of the original chemical list.
entries.zh: 编辑在转录原化学清单时保留了alizaein。

entries.en: The pigment index cross-references alizarinopurpurin to purpurin.
entries.zh: 颜料索引把alizarinopurpurin交叉指向红紫素。

entries.en: The hearing notice identifies the ALJ assigned to the case.
entries.zh: 听证通知写明了负责该案的行政法官。

entries.meaningZh: alkali poisoning：碱中毒或碱性物质中毒的旧表述
entries.en: The historical medical index includes a heading for alkali poisoning.
entries.zh: 历史医学索引中有一项碱中毒标题。

entries.en: The old chemistry glossary defines alkalifiable as capable of being made alkaline.
entries.zh: 旧化学词汇表把alkalifiable解释为可以变成碱性的。

entries.meaningZh: alkalipenia：碱储量减少的旧医学术语
entries.en: The historical glossary lists alkalipenia among acid-base terms.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把alkalipenia列在酸碱相关术语中。

entries.en: The biology glossary uses alkalitropism for orientation towards an alkaline environment.
entries.zh: 生物学词汇表用向碱性表示朝向碱性环境的定向反应。

entries.meaningZh: Alkalosite：历史工业爆破材料商品名
entries.en: The mining-history index lists Alkalosite as a trade name.
entries.zh: 采矿史索引把Alkalosite列为商品名。

entries.en: The historical chemical index cross-references alkarsin to cacodyl oxide.
entries.zh: 历史化学索引把alkarsin交叉指向卡可基氧化物。

entries.en: The old materials catalogue lists Alkathene among trade names.
entries.zh: 旧材料目录把Alkathene列在商品名中。

entries.en: The nomenclature table groups the alkene derivatives together.
entries.zh: 命名表把链烯烃衍生物列在一起。

entries.en: They took a walk along Alki Beach.
entries.zh: 他们沿阿尔基海滩散步。

entries.meaningZh: alkyl iodide：碘代烷；烷基碘化物
entries.en: The nomenclature exercise places the alkyl iodide in a separate category.
entries.zh: 命名练习把碘代烷放在单独类别中。

entries.en: The chemistry exercise distinguishes a ketone from an aldehyde.
entries.zh: 化学练习区分了酮与醛。

entries.meaningZh: alky：酒精或酒鬼的非正式旧称
entries.en: The old memoir uses alky as slang for alcohol.
entries.zh: 旧回忆录用alky作为酒精的俚称。

entries.meaningZh: 烷醇酰胺；含羟烷基取代基的酰胺类
entries.en: The chemist corrected the label from alkylolamine to alkylolamide after checking the structure.
entries.zh: 核查结构后，化学家把标签上的烷醇胺改为烷醇酰胺。

entries.en: The refinery-history index includes alkymer.
entries.zh: 炼油史索引列有烷化油这一旧名。

entries.en: All at once, the lights went out.
entries.zh: 灯突然全灭了。

entries.en: Her place in the final was all but certain.
entries.zh: 她进入决赛几乎已成定局。

entries.meaningZh: all fours：四肢着地，常见于on all fours
entries.en: He got down on all fours to look beneath the sofa.
entries.zh: 他四肢着地，朝沙发下面查看。

entries.meaningZh: all hours：任何时刻；很晚或不规则的时段
entries.en: The café stays open at all hours.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆全天候营业。

entries.meaningZh: all-inclusive：包含所有费用或项目的
entries.en: They chose an all-inclusive package for their holiday.
entries.zh: 他们为假期选了一个全包套餐。

entries.meaningZh: all-nighter：通宵工作或学习的一夜
entries.en: She pulled an all-nighter to finish the presentation.
entries.zh: 她熬了一整夜完成演示稿。

entries.en: The narrow footbridge rests on an all-steel frame.
entries.zh: 这座狭窄的人行桥支撑在全钢框架上。

entries.meaningZh: all the way：一路；从头到尾
entries.en: She carried the sleeping child all the way home.
entries.zh: 她一路抱着熟睡的孩子回家。

entries.meaningZh: all too：实在太；非常，常带遗憾意味
entries.en: The mistake was all too easy to make.
entries.zh: 这个错误实在太容易犯了。

entries.meaningZh: all up：彻底结束、无望，常见于all up with
entries.en: When the last train was cancelled, it was all up with our plans.
entries.zh: 最后一班火车取消后，我们的计划彻底泡汤了。

entries.en: The café advertised an all-you-can-drink tea offer.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆宣传了一项茶水不限量的优惠。

entries.meaningZh: alla breve：以二分音符为拍的二拍子方式演奏
entries.en: The conductor took the passage alla breve.
entries.zh: 指挥把这一段按二拍子方式处理。

entries.en: The historical chemistry glossary places allalocatalytic beside other catalytic terms.
entries.zh: 历史化学词汇表把allalocatalytic与其他催化术语并列。

entries.meaningZh: allatectomy：昆虫咽侧体切除术的名称
entries.en: The entomology-history index includes allatectomy.
entries.zh: 昆虫学史索引列有咽侧体切除术。

entries.meaningZh: alle：德语的所有人或所有的
entries.en: The German notice uses alle to mean everyone.
entries.zh: 德语通知用alle表示所有人。

entries.meaningZh: allelochemistry：化感物质及其化学作用的研究
entries.en: The ecology bibliography includes a section on allelochemistry.
entries.zh: 生态学参考书目中有一部分介绍化感化学。

entries.meaningZh: allelotaxis：原资料中的多源胚质发生旧术语
entries.en: The historical embryology glossary retains allelotaxis as a separate entry.
entries.zh: 历史胚胎学词汇表把allelotaxis保留为独立条目。

entries.meaningZh: allelotropism：互相趋向或相互吸引的生物学旧术语
entries.en: The old biology text uses allelotropism for mutual orientation.
entries.zh: 旧生物学教材用allelotropism表示相互定向。

entries.meaningZh: allemagtig：南非荷兰语的天哪或全能者啊
entries.en: Allemagtig, what a storm!
entries.zh: 天哪，多大的暴风雨！

entries.meaningZh: allenthesis：异物入体的旧医学名称
entries.en: The historical medical index includes allenthesis.
entries.zh: 历史医学索引列有异物入体这一旧名。

entries.en: The archived brochure carries the Allergan name.
entries.zh: 存档宣传册印着艾尔建的名称。

entries.en: The French leaflet uses allergie where the English version says allergy.
entries.zh: 法语说明页使用allergie，而英语版使用allergy。

entries.en: The old medical glossary gives allergosis as a general category.
entries.zh: 旧医学词汇表把过敏性疾病列为一个总类。

entries.en: A narrow alleyway led to the back of the theatre.
entries.zh: 一条窄巷通向剧院后门。

entries.en: The protocol notes list ALLF in the glossary.
entries.zh: 协议笔记在词汇表中列出了附加低层功能。

entries.en: The old geological catalogue records an allgovite sample.
entries.zh: 旧地质目录记录了一件辉绿玢岩样品。

entries.en: The textile archive keeps a swatch labelled Allibanis.
entries.zh: 纺织档案保存着一块标为Allibanis的布样。

entries.en: The compound-name index includes allicinol.
entries.zh: 化合物名称索引中列有蒜醇。

entries.en: She finally found the all-important reference number.
entries.zh: 她终于找到了那个至关重要的参考编号。

entries.en: The chemistry glossary cross-references allo-isomerism to stereoisomerism.
entries.zh: 化学词汇表把allo-isomerism交叉指向立体异构。

entries.meaningZh: allobar：与同位素形式有关的旧物理学名称
entries.en: The old physics index groups allobar with isotope-related terminology.
entries.zh: 旧物理学索引把allobar与同位素相关术语编在一起。

entries.meaningZh: Allobroges：阿洛布罗基人，古代高卢族群
entries.en: The history chapter discusses the Allobroges among the peoples of ancient Gaul.
entries.zh: 历史章节在古代高卢各族群中介绍了阿洛布罗基人。

entries.meaningZh: allocarpy：植物异果性相关旧术语
entries.en: The old botany index places allocarpy among terms concerning fruit.
entries.zh: 旧植物学索引把allocarpy列在果实相关术语中。

entries.meaningZh: allochemical：他化的；与外来沉积组分有关的
entries.en: The sedimentology chapter describes the grains as allochemical.
entries.zh: 沉积学章节把这些颗粒描述为他化组分。

entries.en: The nomenclature table distinguishes allocholane from cholane.
entries.zh: 命名表区分了别胆烷与胆烷。

entries.en: The old steroid index gives allocholestanone a separate entry.
entries.zh: 旧甾体索引为allocholestanone设有独立条目。

entries.en: The mineralogy glossary explains allochroism as a change in colour.
entries.zh: 矿物学词汇表把allochroism解释为变色。

entries.meaningZh: AllocMem：分配内存的程序函数名
entries.en: The code example calls AllocMem before using the temporary buffer.
entries.zh: 代码示例在使用临时缓冲区前调用AllocMem。

entries.meaningZh: allocyclic：由外部因素控制的周期性的，地质学用语
entries.en: The geology chapter contrasts allocyclic changes with internally generated cycles.
entries.zh: 地质学章节把外部因素引起的周期变化与内部产生的周期作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: alloemicymarin：原资料中的旧化合物名称
entries.en: The chemical archivist retained alloemicymarin in the name index.
entries.zh: 化学档案管理员在名称索引中保留了alloemicymarin。

entries.meaningZh: allogotrophia：原资料中尚未确认规范对应的旧术语
entries.en: The translator retained allogotrophia while flagging its unclear gloss.
entries.zh: 译者保留了allogotrophia，同时标出它的释义不清。

entries.meaningZh: alloiogenesis：异态或世代交替的旧名称
entries.en: The historical biology glossary lists alloiogenesis among terms for alternating forms.
entries.zh: 历史生物学词汇表把alloiogenesis列在形态交替相关术语中。

entries.en: The mineral inventory includes a sample labelled allokite.
entries.zh: 矿物清单中有一件标为铝英高岭石的样品。

entries.meaningZh: allomethylose：阿洛甲基糖，旧糖类名称
entries.en: The historical carbohydrate index includes allomethylose.
entries.zh: 历史糖类索引列有阿洛甲基糖。

entries.en: The sedimentology collection includes an allomicrite sample.
entries.zh: 沉积学收藏中有一件异地泥晶灰岩样品。

entries.en: The endings /s/, /z/ and /ɪz/ are allomorphs of the English plural morpheme.
entries.zh: 词尾/s/、/z/和/ɪz/是英语复数语素的不同语音变体。

entries.en: The historical glossary uses allomorphosis for a change of form.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表用allomorphosis表示形态变化。

entries.en: The antibiotic-name index retains allomycin as a historical entry.
entries.zh: 抗生素名称索引把别霉素保留为历史条目。

entries.meaningZh: allonymous：以他人姓名署名的；用别名的
entries.en: The catalogue notes that the pamphlet was published under an allonymous name.
entries.zh: 目录注明，这本小册子以他人姓名署名出版。

entries.en: The old ecology glossary describes the two forms as allopelagic.
entries.zh: 旧生态学词汇表把这两种类型描述为生活在不同水深。

entries.en: The nomenclature chart includes an entry for the allophanyl group.
entries.zh: 命名图表包含一个脲基甲酰基条目。

entries.en: The historical glossary places allophemy among speech-related terms.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把allophemy列在言语相关术语中。

entries.meaningZh: alloplasm：异源细胞质或异质的旧细胞学名称
entries.en: The cytology glossary distinguishes alloplasm from the cell nucleus.
entries.zh: 细胞学词汇表区分了异质与细胞核。

entries.meaningZh: allopsyche：面向外界的意识或心理活动的旧称
entries.en: The historical psychology glossary contrasts allopsyche with the sense of self.
entries.zh: 历史心理学词汇表把外界意识与自我意识作了对比。

entries.en: The pharmacy archive preserves an Allopyrine packet.
entries.zh: 药学档案保存着一个Allopyrine包装。

entries.en: The rock description refers to the grains' allotriomorphism.
entries.zh: 岩石描述提到了颗粒的他形性质。

entries.en: The ecology chapter compares two allospecies that occupy different regions.
entries.zh: 生态学章节比较了分布在不同地区的两个异域近缘种。

entries.meaningZh: allosteatodes：皮脂分泌异常的旧形容词
entries.en: The old medical glossary labels allosteatodes as an adjective relating to abnormal sebum secretion.
entries.zh: 旧医学词汇表把allosteatodes标为与皮脂分泌异常有关的形容词。

entries.en: The genetics glossary contrasts allosynapsis with other forms of pairing.
entries.zh: 遗传学词汇表将异源联会与其他配对形式作了对比。

entries.en: The mineral diagram labels the irregularly bounded crystal an allotriomorph.
entries.zh: 矿物示意图把边界不规则的晶体标为他形体。

entries.en: The geological plate labels one grain allotrioblast.
entries.zh: 地质图版把一个颗粒标为他形变晶。

entries.en: The mineralogy notes explain allotriomorphism through irregular crystal boundaries.
entries.zh: 矿物学笔记通过不规则晶体边界解释他形性质。

entries.meaningZh: all'ottava：高或低八度演奏，依乐谱标记
entries.en: The score directs the pianist to play the passage all'ottava.
entries.zh: 乐谱要求钢琴家将这一段移高或移低八度演奏。

entries.meaningZh: alloxuraemia：血中嘌呤碱增多的旧名称
entries.en: The historical medical index lists alloxuraemia among metabolic terms.
entries.zh: 历史医学索引把alloxuraemia列在代谢相关术语中。

entries.meaningZh: 合金化电接触；经合金化形成的金属—半导体电接触（本例电子器件）
entries.en: Her slide compared an alloyed contact with a non-alloyed contact.
entries.zh: 她的幻灯片比较了合金化电接触与非合金化电接触。

entries.meaningZh: 等位酶；同一基因座的不同等位基因所决定的酶变体
entries.en: The two populations differed in the frequency of one allozyme.
entries.zh: 两个种群中某一种等位酶的频率不同。

entries.en: He bought an all-purpose tool for small household repairs.
entries.zh: 他买了一件用于家中小修小补的多用途工具。

entries.en: All's quiet in the house now.
entries.zh: 屋里现在一片安静。

entries.en: It became her all-time favourite song.
entries.zh: 它成了她一直以来最喜欢的歌。

entries.en: The historical materials table lists Allumen among alloy names.
entries.zh: 历史材料表把Allumen列在合金名称中。

entries.meaningZh: 总是；一直（方言或口语写法，相当于always）
entries.en: 'I've allus lived here,' the old gardener replied.
entries.zh: ‘我一直都住在这里，’老园丁回答道。

entries.en: The chemical-name index cross-references allylacetonitrile to pent-4-enenitrile.
entries.zh: 化学名称索引把烯丙基乙腈交叉指向4-戊烯腈。

entries.meaningZh: allylisulfocarbamide：原资料中的烯丙基含硫化合物旧名
entries.en: The historical chemical catalogue retains allylisulfocarbamide in the name column.
entries.zh: 历史化学目录在名称栏保留了allylisulfocarbamide。

entries.en: The two groups became allies during the campaign.
entries.zh: 两个团体在活动期间成为盟友。

entries.meaningZh: almacenista：西班牙语的仓库经营者；亦见于雪利酒行业称呼
entries.en: The wine-history essay discusses the role of the almacenista.
entries.zh: 葡萄酒史文章讨论了仓储酒商的角色。

entries.en: The industrial archive includes an Almalec sample label.
entries.zh: 工业档案中有一张Almalec样品标签。

entries.meaningZh: almanacking：编写或查阅历书的活动，旧式用语
entries.en: The old essay jokes about the farmer's habit of almanacking.
entries.zh: 旧随笔打趣地写到农民查历书的习惯。

entries.en: The mineral cabinet keeps the old name almashite on its label.
entries.zh: 矿物柜的标签上保留着绿琥珀这一旧名。

entries.en: Over that small interval, the curve is almost linear.
entries.zh: 在那个很小的区间内，曲线近似线性。

entries.meaningZh: ALN：属性层号的原缩略标记
entries.en: The drawing table gives each layer an ALN.
entries.zh: 绘图表为每一层列出一个属性层号。

entries.meaningZh: alnic：铝镍铁磁性合金的旧名称
entries.en: The materials catalogue lists alnic beside other magnetic alloys.
entries.zh: 材料目录把alnic与其他磁性合金并列。

entries.en: The computer-science diagram labels the arithmetic-logical operation ALO.
entries.zh: 计算机科学示意图用ALO标记算术逻辑运算。

entries.en: The old fabric chart labels the pale brown shade aloma.
entries.zh: 旧布料色卡把这种浅褐色标为aloma。

entries.en: She was alone in the reading room.
entries.zh: 阅览室里只有她一个人。

entries.en: The shipping record gives an alongside date in the final column.
entries.zh: 航运记录在最后一栏列出靠泊日期。

entries.meaningZh: Alopex；包含北极狐的犬科属名（本例旧分类语境）
entries.en: The old zoology textbook placed the Arctic fox in Alopex.
entries.zh: 这本旧动物学教科书把北极狐归入Alopex属。

entries.meaningZh: Alouette：加拿大早期电离层研究卫星名称
entries.en: The space-history display includes a model of Alouette.
entries.zh: 航天史展陈中有一个Alouette卫星模型。

entries.meaningZh: alpach：阿尔卑斯地区暖风的旧名称
entries.en: The old weather glossary describes alpach as a thawing wind.
entries.zh: 旧气象词汇表把alpach描述为带来解冻的暖风。

entries.meaningZh: alpenstich：阿尔卑斯地区肺炎的旧称
entries.en: The medical-history index preserves the regional term alpenstich.
entries.zh: 医学史索引保留了alpenstich这一地方旧名。

entries.en: The old carbohydrate table distinguishes alpha-acrose from its similarly named entries.
entries.zh: 旧糖类表把α-阿柯糖与名称相近的条目区分开。

entries.meaningZh: alpha carbon：α碳，邻近指定官能团等的碳原子位置名
entries.en: The diagram marks the alpha carbon with an arrow.
entries.zh: 示意图用箭头标出了α碳。

entries.en: The physics textbook illustrates alpha decay with a schematic diagram.
entries.zh: 物理教材用示意图解释了α衰变。

entries.en: The pharmacy archive lists alpha-eucaine among older drug names.
entries.zh: 药学档案把α-优卡因列在较旧的药物名称中。

entries.meaningZh: alpha-leukocyte：旧血液学中的α型白细胞名称
entries.en: The historical blood-cell chart includes alpha-leukocyte.
entries.zh: 历史血细胞图表列有alpha-leukocyte。

entries.en: The nomenclature table places the alpha olefins in one group.
entries.zh: 命名表把α烯烃列为一组。

entries.en: The old physics diagram labels the alpha ray with the Greek letter α.
entries.zh: 旧物理示意图用希腊字母α标记α射线。

entries.en: The reaction-name glossary includes alpha substitution.
entries.zh: 反应名称词汇表列有α位取代。

entries.en: The chemical index distinguishes alpha-tocopherol from other tocopherols.
entries.zh: 化学索引把α-生育酚与其他生育酚区分开。

entries.en: Alphabetisation made the long list easier to search.
entries.zh: 按字母顺序排列后，这份长名单更容易查找了。

entries.meaningZh: alphabetography：字母书写或字母系统研究的旧称
entries.en: The historical linguistics index includes alphabetography.
entries.zh: 历史语言学索引中列有alphabetography。

entries.en: The form requires an alphanumeric reference code.
entries.zh: 表格要求填写由字母和数字组成的参考代码。

entries.meaningZh: 用逐像素编码来显示字母数字及照片图像的（旧视讯图文显示技术）
entries.en: The museum demonstration used an alphaphotographic display to show the scanned picture.
entries.zh: 博物馆的演示用逐像素编码的视讯图文显示方式呈现扫描图像。

entries.meaningZh: Alphatron：α粒子电离式真空计的名称
entries.en: The instrument museum includes an Alphatron gauge.
entries.zh: 仪器博物馆中有一台Alphatron真空计。

entries.meaningZh: alphazurine：历史染料或指示剂名称
entries.en: The old dye index lists alphazurine in the colour-name column.
entries.zh: 旧染料索引把alphazurine列在色名一栏。

entries.meaningZh: alphonsia：三爪取弹钳的历史名称
entries.en: The surgical-history catalogue includes an instrument labelled alphonsia.
entries.zh: 外科史目录中有一件标为alphonsia的器械。

entries.meaningZh: alphyl group：旧化学命名中的基团名称，资料间义项有歧义
entries.en: The editor kept alphyl group in quotation marks when transcribing the old glossary.
entries.zh: 编辑转录旧词汇表时，把alphyl group保留在引号中。

entries.en: The plant-compound index retains alpinin as an older name.
entries.zh: 植物化合物索引把alpinin保留为旧名。

entries.en: The landscape glossary uses alpland for high mountain terrain.
entries.zh: 地貌词汇表用alpland表示高山地带。

entries.meaningZh: Alpujarras：西班牙阿尔普哈拉斯地区
entries.en: The travel memoir describes walking through the Alpujarras.
entries.zh: 旅行回忆录描写了在阿尔普哈拉斯地区徒步的经历。

entries.meaningZh: alsad：树丛植物的旧生态学名称
entries.en: The old ecology glossary places alsad among habitat-based plant terms.
entries.zh: 旧生态学词汇表把alsad列在按生境命名的植物术语中。

entries.en: The materials archive records Alsex in an alloy table.
entries.zh: 材料档案在合金表中记录了Alsex。

entries.meaningZh: Alsimag：高频绝缘陶瓷材料的商品名
entries.en: The old component catalogue labels the insulating part Alsimag.
entries.zh: 旧元件目录把绝缘部件标为Alsimag。

entries.meaningZh: also-ran：落选者；未获名次的参赛者
entries.en: The once-promising candidate ended up an also-ran.
entries.zh: 那位一度很有希望的候选人最终成了落选者。

entries.meaningZh: alstonamine：鸡骨常山胺，旧生物碱名称
entries.en: The alkaloid-name index uses the spelling alstonamine.
entries.zh: 生物碱名称索引使用alstonamine这一拼写。

entries.en: The geology map labels the Altaides across central Asia.
entries.zh: 地质图在中亚区域标出了阿尔泰造山带。

entries.en: An altar-like stone table stood in the centre of the room.
entries.zh: 房间中央放着一张像祭坛的石桌。

entries.en: The historical disease glossary includes altauna.
entries.zh: 历史疾病词汇表列有顽固性痈这一旧名。

entries.meaningZh: alternariatoxicosis：链格孢毒素相关中毒的名称
entries.en: The veterinary glossary includes alternariatoxicosis among fungal-toxin terms.
entries.zh: 兽医学词汇表把链格孢毒素相关中毒列在真菌毒素术语中。

entries.meaningZh: alterably：以可改变的方式，罕见用语
entries.en: The old legal note treats the arrangement as alterably settled.
entries.zh: 旧法律笔记把这项安排视为可更改的约定。

entries.meaningZh: alternando：更比地，数学比例变换的拉丁用语
entries.en: The proof uses alternando to rearrange the proportion.
entries.zh: 证明用更比法变换这个比例。

entries.meaningZh: alternate-form：复本的；采用另一等价形式的
entries.en: The researcher used an alternate-form version of the questionnaire.
entries.zh: 研究人员使用了这份问卷的另一等价版本。

entries.en: The report compares alternative fuels without recommending one.
entries.zh: 报告比较了多种替代燃料，但没有推荐其中一种。

entries.en: The radio programme focuses on alternative music.
entries.zh: 这个广播节目主要播放另类音乐。

entries.meaningZh: alternizer：交错化装置或作用的旧名称
entries.en: The old circuit index includes alternizer.
entries.zh: 旧电路索引中列有alternizer。

entries.en: The vegetation scheme uses altherbosa for tall-herb communities.
entries.zh: 植被分类方案用altherbosa表示高草群落。

entries.meaningZh: alt. hor.：拉丁语alternis horis，每两小时一次的旧医嘱缩写
entries.en: The medical historian explains the Latin abbreviation alt. hor.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者解释了alt. hor.这一拉丁缩写。

entries.en: The surface-treatment history lists alitizing.
entries.zh: 表面处理史列有渗铝处理。

entries.meaningZh: altiscope：用于从较低处观察高处的旧式光学器具
entries.en: The instrument museum displayed an altiscope.
entries.zh: 仪器博物馆展出了一件旧式高度望远器。

entries.meaningZh: altoherbiprata：高草草本群落的旧生态学名称
entries.en: The old vegetation map places altoherbiprata beside lower grassland.
entries.zh: 旧植被图把高草草本群落与较低矮草地并列。

entries.en: Altorfer labelled each drawer in the archive room.
entries.zh: 阿尔托弗给档案室每个抽屉都贴了标签。

entries.meaningZh: altostratocumulus：旧云分类中的高层积云名称
entries.en: The historical weather chart includes altostratocumulus.
entries.zh: 历史气象图中列有高层积云。

entries.meaningZh: altricial：孵化或出生后需长期哺育的
entries.en: The biology chapter contrasts altricial chicks with more independent hatchlings.
entries.zh: 生物学章节比较了需要长期哺育的雏鸟与较独立的初生幼鸟。

entries.meaningZh: altus：拉丁语高的；亦见旧声部名称
entries.en: The early vocal score names one part altus.
entries.zh: 早期声乐谱把其中一个声部称为altus。

entries.meaningZh: Aludip：热镀铝钢板相关工艺或材料名
entries.en: The materials catalogue includes an Aludip sample label.
entries.zh: 材料目录中有一张Aludip样品标签。

entries.meaningZh: ALUE：可容许的线性无偏估计量
entries.en: The statistics notes define ALUE in a list of estimators.
entries.zh: 统计笔记在估计量表中定义了可容许的线性无偏估计量。

entries.meaningZh: Aluflex：原资料中的锰铝合金名称
entries.en: The old cable catalogue lists Aluflex among material names.
entries.zh: 旧电缆目录把Aluflex列在材料名称中。

entries.en: The bird diagram labels the alulet near the wing base.
entries.zh: 鸟类示意图在翅基附近标出了小翼。

entries.en: The histology index lists alum haematoxylin among stain names.
entries.zh: 组织学索引把明矾苏木精列在染色剂名称中。

entries.meaningZh: Aluman：含锰铝合金的旧商品名
entries.en: The historical materials table includes Aluman.
entries.zh: 历史材料表中列有Aluman。

entries.en: The mineral index includes alumchromite.
entries.zh: 矿物索引中列有铝铬铁矿。

entries.en: The analytical-reagent index lists aluminon.
entries.zh: 分析试剂索引列有试铝灵。

entries.en: The materials table lists an aluminium-nickel alloy.
entries.zh: 材料表中列有一种铝镍合金。

entries.en: The old mineral index cross-references alumoberyl to chrysoberyl.
entries.zh: 旧矿物索引把alumoberyl交叉指向金绿宝石。

entries.en: The mineral catalogue includes an alumochromite specimen.
entries.zh: 矿物目录中有一件铝铬铁矿标本。

entries.en: The geological collection has a sample labelled alumohematite.
entries.zh: 地质收藏中有一件标为铝赤铁矿的样品。

entries.en: The old quarry map marks a deposit of alumstone.
entries.zh: 旧采石场地图标出了一处明矾石矿层。

entries.meaningZh: Aluneon：原资料中的锌铜镍铝合金商品名
entries.en: The historical materials table lists Aluneon.
entries.zh: 历史材料表列有Aluneon。

entries.meaningZh: alusia：迷惘或精神混乱的旧名称
entries.en: The medical historian preserved alusia in the original case heading.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者在原病例标题中保留了alusia。

entries.en: The old inventory describes the pouch as made of aluta.
entries.zh: 旧清单把小袋的材料写作精制软革。

entries.en: The robotics poster shows an ALV following a marked path.
entries.zh: 机器人海报展示了一辆沿标记路线行驶的自主地面车辆。

entries.meaningZh: the Alvarezes：阿尔瓦雷斯一家人
entries.en: The Alvarezes brought folding chairs to the picnic.
entries.zh: 阿尔瓦雷斯一家带着折叠椅来参加野餐。

entries.en: The food-science report includes an alveogram.
entries.zh: 食品科学报告中有一张面团吹泡张力曲线图。

entries.en: The old description calls the porous structure alveolitoid.
entries.zh: 旧描述把这个多孔结构称为泡状的。

entries.en: The antibiotic-name index includes alveomycin.
entries.zh: 抗生素名称索引中列有蜂窝霉素。

entries.meaningZh: alvi：拉丁语alvus的变格形式，与腹或肠有关
entries.en: The Latin exercise identifies alvi as a form of alvus.
entries.zh: 拉丁语练习把alvi识别为alvus的变格形式。

entries.en: The bilingual glossary pairs alvus with abdomen.
entries.zh: 双语词汇表把alvus与腹部配对。

entries.meaningZh: ALX：中文游戏社群对阿拉希盆地的拼音缩略标记
entries.en: The guild chat used ALX for the Arathi Basin battleground.
entries.zh: 公会聊天用ALX表示阿拉希盆地战场。

entries.meaningZh: alymphocytosis：淋巴细胞缺乏的旧名称
entries.en: The historical blood-cell glossary includes alymphocytosis.
entries.zh: 历史血细胞词汇表列有淋巴细胞缺乏这一旧名。

entries.en: The pharmacy archive keeps an Alypine label.
entries.zh: 药学档案保存着一张Alypine标签。

entries.meaningZh: alysosis：无聊或不安状态的旧医学名
entries.en: The historical glossary lists alysosis among terms for mental states.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把alysosis列在精神状态相关术语中。

entries.meaningZh: Amada：天田，日本制造企业名称
entries.en: The workshop had an old Amada machine manual.
entries.zh: 工作间里有一本旧天田机器手册。

entries.meaningZh: Amadis：阿马迪斯，骑士传奇人物名
entries.en: The essay discusses Amadis as a model of the chivalric hero.
entries.zh: 文章把阿马迪斯作为骑士英雄的典型来讨论。

entries.en: The postcard showed a beach near Amagansett.
entries.zh: 明信片上是一处阿默甘西特附近的海滩。

entries.en: The mineral drawer contains an amakinite specimen.
entries.zh: 矿物抽屉中有一件羟铁矿标本。

entries.en: The French menu lists a cake aux amandes.
entries.zh: 法语菜单上列着一款杏仁蛋糕。

entries.meaningZh: amara：苦味药的拉丁语复数称呼，历史药学用语
entries.en: The old pharmacy catalogue groups several entries under amara.
entries.zh: 旧药学目录把几项制剂归在苦味药标题之下。

entries.meaningZh: amarbeline：苦杏贝灵，原资料中的旧化合物名
entries.en: The historical chemical index retains amarbeline.
entries.zh: 历史化学索引保留了amarbeline这一名称。

entries.meaningZh: amargosa：苦楝相关药材的旧名称
entries.en: The historical botanical index lists amargosa as a bark name.
entries.zh: 历史植物学索引把amargosa列为一种树皮名称。

entries.meaningZh: amarin：苦杏精，2,4,5-三苯基咪唑啉的旧名称
entries.en: The chemical index cross-references amarin to its systematic name.
entries.zh: 化学索引把amarin交叉指向其系统名称。

entries.meaningZh: AMAX：旧资料中的信件暂存区管理工具名
entries.en: The software archive includes an AMAX utility manual.
entries.zh: 软件档案中有一本AMAX工具手册。

entries.en: The Brazilian address ends with the state abbreviation AM.
entries.zh: 巴西地址的末尾写着亚马孙州缩写AM。

entries.meaningZh: amazone：骑马女装或女性骑手的法语借词旧用法
entries.en: The costume catalogue describes the riding outfit as an amazone.
entries.zh: 服饰目录把这套骑装称为amazone。

entries.meaningZh: Ambac：美国金融担保公司名称
entries.en: The financial-history archive includes an Ambac annual report.
entries.zh: 金融史档案中有一份Ambac年报。

entries.en: She served as an ambassador-at-large for cultural affairs.
entries.zh: 她曾担任负责文化事务的无任所大使。

entries.meaningZh: ambelline：安贝灵，植物生物碱名称
entries.en: The alkaloid-name index lists ambelline.
entries.zh: 生物碱名称索引中列有安贝灵。

entries.en: The collection includes a small amber glass bottle.
entries.zh: 收藏中有一只琥珀色玻璃小瓶。

entries.meaningZh: ambicoloration：两面着色或两侧显色现象
entries.en: The zoology glossary gives ambicoloration a separate entry.
entries.zh: 动物学词汇表为两面显色现象设有独立条目。

entries.en: She could draw ambidextrously, switching hands without hesitation.
entries.zh: 她能用两只手同样灵巧地画画，换手毫不迟疑。

entries.meaningZh: ambilevosity：两手都不灵巧，旧式用语
entries.en: The old essay uses ambilevosity for clumsiness with both hands.
entries.zh: 旧随笔用ambilevosity表示双手都不灵巧。

entries.meaningZh: ambiophony：立体声混响系统或效果
entries.en: The concert-hall brochure describes an ambiophony system.
entries.zh: 音乐厅宣传册描述了一套立体混响系统。

entries.meaningZh: ambiplasma：物质与反物质构成的假设等离子体混合物
entries.en: The cosmology lecture presents ambiplasma as a hypothetical mixture.
entries.zh: 宇宙学讲课把ambiplasma介绍为一种假设的混合物。

entries.meaningZh: ambisexuality：兼具两性特征的性质，旧用语
entries.en: The historical psychology glossary treats ambisexuality as a descriptive term.
entries.zh: 历史心理学词汇表把ambisexuality作为描述性术语处理。

entries.meaningZh: ambloma：希腊旧医学中与流产有关的名称
entries.en: The Greek medical glossary explains ambloma as a term connected with miscarriage.
entries.zh: 希腊医学词汇表把ambloma解释为与流产有关的术语。

entries.en: The historical glossary cross-references amblyacousia to reduced hearing.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把amblyacousia交叉指向听觉减退。

entries.en: The medical terminology list distinguishes amblygeustia from loss of smell.
entries.zh: 医学术语表区分了味觉迟钝与嗅觉丧失。

entries.meaningZh: amblyopiatrics：弱视矫正的旧学科名称
entries.en: The medical-history index has a heading for amblyopiatrics.
entries.zh: 医学史索引有一个弱视矫正的标题。

entries.en: The mineral collection preserves the label amblystegite.
entries.zh: 矿物收藏保留着amblystegite这一标签。

entries.meaningZh: amboceptorgen：旧免疫学中的双受体原名称
entries.en: The historical immunology chart uses the name amboceptorgen.
entries.zh: 历史免疫学图表使用了amboceptorgen这一名称。

entries.meaningZh: ambotoxoid：旧资料中的综合类毒素名称
entries.en: The medical historian retained ambotoxoid in the original product list.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者在原始产品清单中保留了ambotoxoid。

entries.meaningZh: ambrein：龙涎香脂或龙涎香醇的名称
entries.en: The perfumery glossary cross-references ambrain to ambrein.
entries.zh: 香料词汇表把ambrain交叉指向ambrein。

entries.meaningZh: ambrettolide：黄葵内酯，香料物质名称
entries.en: The perfumery glossary lists ambrettolide as a fragrance ingredient.
entries.zh: 香料词汇表把黄葵内酯列为香料成分。

entries.meaningZh: ambrosiac：香甜宜人的；如神仙美食般的
entries.en: The ripe fruit had an almost ambrosiac fragrance.
entries.zh: 熟水果散发着近乎仙馔般美妙的香气。

entries.en: The sterol-name index includes ambrosterol.
entries.zh: 甾醇名称索引中列有ambrosterol。

entries.en: The handwritten equipment log shortens ambulance to ambu.
entries.zh: 手写设备日志把救护车缩写为ambu.。

entries.meaningZh: ambulante：历史法国家具中的移动茶几
entries.en: The antiques catalogue describes the small tea table as an ambulante.
entries.zh: 古董目录把这张小茶几称为ambulante。

entries.meaningZh: ambulatory care：门诊照护；不需住院的医疗服务
entries.en: The health-services report has a chapter on ambulatory care.
entries.zh: 医疗服务报告有一章介绍门诊照护。

entries.meaningZh: amburgos：旧式重浆白衬衫布名称
entries.en: The textile catalogue keeps a swatch labelled amburgos.
entries.zh: 纺织目录保存着一块标为amburgos的布样。
